description: ACDC-OpFlow, Unified, Cross-Language Framework for AC/DC Optimal Power Flow Solutions is a software deposit deposited in 4TU.ResearchData by its authors Haixiao Li, Azadeh Kermansaravi. Repository with Optimal Power Flow (OPF) library in Julia, Python, MATLAB, and C++ done as a part of the Harmony project (HARMONic stabilitY assessment of PE-penetrated power systems).Hybrid AC/voltage source converter-based multi-terminal DC (VSC-MTDC) power grids enable long-distance power transmission and flexible interconnection between AC grids. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. Formats: CSV. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is MIT. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-4tu-repository.
